educationalGoal:
学習・教育目標
In this course, students will learn methods to transform society through specializ
ed study of the SDGs.
In addition, by developing SDG gamification materials, students will deepen their
understanding of the SDGs, experience the process of developing their own products
 and making them better, and acquire the thinking necessary to explore ways of soc
ial change in the process.
advice:
Since 2016, activities have been taking place around the world to achieve the SDGs, which are common goals for a
ll UN member states.
In this class, students will learn an overview of the SDGs and how they can actually create their own actions an
d involve others.
In particular, the second half of the class will focus on the development and utilization of gamification materi
als and social implementation, deepening students' understanding of how to create activities that improve societ
y while having fun at the same time.

ial change in the process.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Since 2016, activities have been taking place around the world to achieve the SDGs, which are common goals for a
ll UN member states.
In this class, students will learn an overview of the SDGs and how they can actually create their own actions an
d involve others.
In particular, the second half of the class will focus on the development and utilization of gamification materi
als and social implementation, deepening students' understanding of how to create activities that improve societ
y while having fun at the same time.
